recommendation.summary: Best-supported heart-rate accuracy at $199 without essential paywalls; Garmin vivosmart 5 is the cheaper subscription-free alternative.

tradeoffs.text: Some extras like AI coach are paywalled; not rugged

alternatives.when: Only if you accept possible Premium for sleep stages

caveats: No verified independent sleep-accuracy data for any specific model
nextSteps: Check current price and return policy
Compare against a reference device for a week

contradictions.assessment: Steady State says most accurate; Popular Science says not accurate. Neither cites data; unresolved, avoid relying on it.
Tom's Guide says detailed sleep reports, only AI trends need Premium; Steady State says stages and score need Premium. Tom's Guide is hands-on and higher reliability, but unresolved.
Steady State misstates the Terra data it cites; Terra itself says Garmin was most consistent. Trust Terra, but it measures consistency, not accuracy.

uncertainties.text: No source provides reference-grade sleep accuracy for any sub-$200 device
Balance HR accuracy comes from journalistic testing, not lab data
Garmin vivosmart 5 evidence is from a 2023 review
